tasks.subject: Task 1: Week-segment calendar model
tasks.description:
Add a `Segment` type and `calendar::segments(&Month)` slicing a month into per-week segments (boundary at day 1 and each week_start), with `first_day`/`last_day`/`id`/`date_range(month)` -> 'MM.DD – MM.DD' padded. Tests in tests/calendar.rs.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rmbujo/src/calendar.rs", "crates/rmbujo/tests/calendar.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cd crates/rmbujo && cargo test -p rmbujo --test calendar", "acceptanceCriteria": ["segments() boundaries at day 1 + each week_start, all days covered once in order", "Segment first_day/last_day/id/date_range padded incl single-day", "boundaries match week_start flags for sun and mon"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Typst preamble PLAN/RETRO icons + week tab
tasks.description:
Add `plan-icon` (bullseye), `retro-icon` (CCW arrow as segment fan + arrowhead), `wtab(seg)` (two-cell link tab) to build_preamble in src/render/doc.rs. Double all literal braces (Rust raw format string). Compile smoke test in tests/render.rs.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rmbujo/src/render/doc.rs", "crates/rmbujo/tests/render.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cd crates/rmbujo && cargo test -p rmbujo --test render preamble_icons", "acceptanceCriteria": ["plan-icon/retro-icon/wtab defined and compile", "wtab two cells link wplan-/wretro- with correct fills", "page using all three compiles to non-empty PDF"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Month-index week dividers + tabs
tasks.description:
MonthlyView::render places a zero-height rule + wtab(d.day) at monthly_row_center(sp,i)-sp/2 for each boundary day (i==0 or d.week_start), out-of-flow so day rows do not shift. Extend label_sink with wplan-/wretro- 1..=31. Regenerate monthly_view golden.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rmbujo/src/templates.rs", "crates/rmbujo/tests/visual.rs", "crates/rmbujo/tests/goldens/monthly_view.png"], "verifyCommand": "cd crates/rmbujo && cargo test -p rmbujo --test visual visual_regression", "acceptanceCriteria": ["rule + wtab placed at boundary Y for each segment", "dividers out-of-flow, all 31 days on page", "label_sink has wplan-/wretro- 1..=31", "visual_regression passes regenerated golden"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: WeeklyPlan and WeeklyRetro page emitters
tasks.description:
Add WeeklyPlan and WeeklyRetro Typst emitters (minimal underlined headers, Month + icon-button links, linked per-day rows; retro is free dot grid). Markup assertions in tests/render.rs; register weekly_plan/weekly_retro golden fragments in tests/visual.rs.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rmbujo/src/templates.rs", "crates/rmbujo/tests/visual.rs", "crates/rmbujo/tests/render.rs", "crates/rmbujo/tests/goldens/weekly_plan.png", "crates/rmbujo/tests/goldens/weekly_retro.png"], "verifyCommand": "cd crates/rmbujo && cargo test -p rmbujo --test render weekly_markup && cargo test -p rmbujo --test visual visual_regression", "acceptanceCriteria": ["WeeklyPlan header+Intentions+Tasks+linked day rows+wplan anchor, no full rule", "WeeklyRetro header+plan button+wretro anchor, free grid", "both dot-pages", "visual_regression + weekly_markup pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Interleave Plan/Retro into month notebook
tasks.description:
build_month_pdf emits MonthlyView, Tasks, then per segment WeeklyPlan -> segment day pages -> WeeklyRetro, agenda pages still last. Update 4 tests/month.rs page-count assertions to derive weekly pages via calendar::segments; run full crate suite.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rmbujo/src/notebooks/month/mod.rs", "crates/rmbujo/tests/month.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cd crates/rmbujo && cargo test -p rmbujo --test month && cargo test -p rmbujo", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fragment order Plan->segment days->Retro per segment, agenda last", "no-events count = 2 + days*pages_per_day + 2*segments", "agenda unchanged, appended only with events", "month.rs derives counts via segments; full suite green"]}
```
